npm-2-1.summary: Manifest.resolve silently loses an own __proto__ dependency key in every assignment branch.
npm-2-1.fix: Collect resolved entries and construct every dependency section with effect/Record.fromEntries. Add a Manifest.test.ts regression preserving all own keys, including __proto__, for concrete and resolver-produced specifiers. Supply verified upstream-bug evidence to the central deviation codemod without editing ledger or Port notes.

npm-2-2.summary: Integrity parsing and conversion retain direct native string helpers forbidden by EF-5.
npm-2-2.fix: Use effect/String slice, indexOf, startsWith, and endsWith at all cited sites, preserving Option-to--1 missing-index behavior, substring cuts, quote handling, and strict base64 validation. Keep the custom base64 sextet loops and validated Number.parseInt hex loop; replace that loop's string slicing without adding a Hex.decode failure channel. Preserve or extend the corresponding IntegrityHash.test.ts contract assertions.

npm-2-3.summary: hexOfBytes hand-builds lowercase hex with native map/padStart/join despite an equivalent Effect encoder.
npm-2-3.fix: Replace the encoder body with Hex.encode(new Uint8Array(bytes)) using effect/encoding/Hex. Retain the strict custom base64 codec and the known digest/canonical SRI inverse assertions in IntegrityHash.test.ts; extend those assertions only if needed for byte-for-byte lowercase hex equivalence.

npm-2-4.summary: matchesPattern uses native pattern.includes instead of the equivalent effect/String helper.
npm-2-4.fix: Replace !pattern.includes("*") with !Str.includes("*")(pattern). Preserve the existing exact-name and two-pointer pnpm wildcard semantics; no test-file edit is required.

npm-2-5.summary: Independent source and optional reason fields lack a normalized source-specific internal union.
npm-2-5.fix: Add annotated manifest/catalog variants without reason and a hooks variant with optional reason. Project the compatible public payload into that internal union through a facade/transform, following NpmRegistry's pattern, and use it for source-specific interpretation. Preserve public tag, fields, messages, cause behavior, and encoded inputs. Add projection regressions in CatalogAssemblyError.test.ts and adjust CatalogAssemblyError.property.test.ts as needed for the normalized contract. Supply any law-forced test adjustments to the central deviation codemod.
